top_sql.query:
SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.content_format, c.parent_id, c.likes, c.status,
		c.created_at, u.name, u.avatar,
		COALESCE(g.name, $4), COALESCE(g.theme_color, $5), COALESCE(g.leader_user_id = c.user_id, $6),
		p.title
		FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id
		JOIN comme

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, CASE WHEN p.content_format = $4 THEN LEFT(regexp_replace(p.content, $5, $6, $7), $8) ELSE LEFT(p.content, $9) END, p.category, p.likes, p.views,
		p.created_at, u.name, u.avatar,
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = $10) AS comment

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, CASE WHEN p.content_format = $4 THEN LEFT(regexp_replace(p.content, $5, $6, $7), $8) ELSE LEFT(p.content, $9) END, p.category, p.likes, p.views,
		p.created_at, u.name, u.avatar,
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = $10) AS comment

SELECT * FROM ((SELECT $4 AS type, p.id, p.title, CASE WHEN p.content_format = $5 THEN LEFT(regexp_replace(p.content, $6, $7, $8), $9) ELSE LEFT(p.content, $10) END AS summary, p.category,
	p.likes, p.views, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
	p.user_id, u.name, u.avatar,
	p.guild_id, g.name, g.theme_color

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c
		WHERE c.parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM comments WHERE user_id = $1 AND status = $2)
		AND c.status = $3 AND c.user_id <> $1

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.content_format, p.category, p.likes, p.views, p.status,
		p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.name, u.avatar, p.guild_id, g.name, g.theme_color,
		COALESCE(ug.name, $2), COALESCE(ug.theme_color, $3), COALESCE(ug.leader_user_id = p.user_id, $4),
		p.published_a

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.content_format, c.parent_id, c.likes, c.status,
		c.created_at, u.name, u.avatar,
		COALESCE(g.name, $3), COALESCE(g.theme_color, $4), COALESCE(g.leader_user_id = c.user_id, $5)
		FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id
		LEFT JOIN guild_membe

SELECT s.user_id FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token=$1 AND s.expires_at > NOW()
		  AND COALESCE(u.is_banned, $2) = $3 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO notifications
		(user_id, type, actor_id, target_type, target_id, context_post_id, context_comment_id, payload, dedupe_key)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9)
		ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key <> $10 DO NOTHING
		RETURNING id

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, CASE WHEN p.content_format = $3 THEN LEFT(regexp_replace(p.content, $4, $5, $6), $7) ELSE LEFT(p.content, $8) END, p.category, p.likes, p.views,
	       p.created_at, u.name, u.avatar,
	       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = $9)
